hero.descriptor: Independent web designer and developer. I design and build websites for businesses, brands and creatives.

philosophy.statement: A website is the first thing a client's customer touches. It should feel considered before anyone reads a word.
design: Hierarchy before decoration: type, proportion and negative space carry the voice.
Composed separately for phone, tablet and desktop, never just shrunk.
Motion used strictly to explain state and answer user action, never to delay reading.
code: Written in clean, semantic TypeScript and React with strict accessibility floors.
Hardware-accelerated transforms and zero layout thrashing for 60fps interaction.
Static-first architecture with ruthless asset budgets so pages load fast anywhere.

process.title: Discover
process.description: We talk through the business, the audience, and what the website has to achieve.
process.youGet: A clear, written project brief and milestone outline.

process.title: Define
process.description: Scope, information architecture and core messaging are agreed before design begins.
process.youGet: Complete sitemap, content model, and technical roadmap.

process.title: Design
process.description: Key pages are designed at real content lengths, specifically for desktop and mobile.
process.youGet: Art-directed interactive designs ready for build.

process.title: Develop
process.description: The site is built in code with production-grade typography, motion, and responsiveness.
process.youGet: A private staging link to test and review.

process.title: Refine
process.description: Rigorous testing across real devices, tuning performance, contrast, and micro-interactions.

process.title: Launch
process.description: Domain, hosting, analytics and SEO setup, followed by a complete walkthrough.

about.lead: I design and build websites myself, so what gets drawn is what ships. The decisions made in the layout are the ones that arrive in the browser.
paragraphs: I work on a small number of projects at a time. That keeps me in the details: how a headline breaks on a phone, how a page loads on a slow connection, what happens when a customer has a very long name or very little patience.
Most of my work is business websites, online stores, landing pages and custom web applications. I am based in India, and collaborate with clients worldwide across multiple time zones.
howIWork: Direct: One point of contact and written updates at agreed intervals.
Careful: Real content, real devices, tested before you see it.
Ready to hand over: You receive clean files, documentation, and a complete walkthrough.
